summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 6 upside misses — STLAP.PA +5%, HEI.DE +4%, BTRW.L +4%, RNO.PA +4%, STJ.L +4%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (IFX.DE -5%, STMPA.PA -5%, AAF.L -4%, EXPN.L -3%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: IFX.DE (-5.30%) — Global chip selloff (SK Hynix -11.5%, Samsung -8%, Micron -8%) on AI-valuation/memory-price fears spilled into European semis; no IFX-specific news, TSMC's strong earnings same day were overshadowed. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe — IFX.DE is a EUR-denominated DAX-listed large-cap (~€87B), and the bot's universes appear scoped to US-listed/ADR tickers, so it never had a chance to react to the sector-wide chip rout.

top_movers.suggestion: Add large-cap Euronext Paris auto names (STLAP.PA, RNO.PA) to the universe, or map STLA's US listing to its Paris primary listing so shipment-data and tariff-driven catalysts are captured pre-open.
